scope: InntQ. revision: nine blue and nine pure black native Figma SVG assets, plus 1x/2x/4x native PNG exports.
method: Closed contour and cyclic segment comparison to clean vector source; exact flat fill check; alpha, bounds and topology checks; source-vector raster comparison at identical pixel dimensions.
notes: Figma SVG canvas dimensions use integer ceil; PNG presets ceil the original fractional frame bounds independently. One-pixel canvas differences against earlier Sharp previews are expected, not geometric stretch.
Native SVG coordinate serialization is rounded; maximum segment deviation is reported in native logical units.
InntQ. has six characters including the original proposal02 period translated horizontally. The five existing letter paths and original period geometry are preserved before export.
visual_review: All eighteen native SVG assets were viewed on a white contact sheet. Blue and pure black sets read consistently, every English-bearing asset includes the final period, both symbol bodies remain separated, and stacked text uses the requested equal-width column and divider. No blank, cropped, distorted, or incomplete asset was observed.
